batch_node.name: Plugin detail page v0.1.0
batch_node.description: The per-plugin detail page at /administrivia/plugin?slug=<slug>, reached from a row on /administrivia/plugins. Two panels over one derivation (plugin_facts.build_plugin_facts): plugin_detail renders identity, provenance, declared-vs-loaded surfaces, both dependency directions, node and edge types with live counts, collectors, recent batches, GRIFT bundles and boot records; plugin_taxonomy draws the type-level graph the plugin DECLARES — node types as nodes, declared edge types as directed edges, cross-plugin endpoints distinguished — with the live counts painted on in three states (a number / declared-never-observed / not observable). Gated above grid.read: the facts route through tap_plugins.report.get_plugin_report(), which authorizes plugins.read in the service layer. The route is a query parameter, not a path segment, because tap_web has no generic path-parameter page route — the gap is named in req-administrivia-v0-plugin-detail-page. discoverable=false: a per-item page is reached from its parent table, not from navigation.

node.name: Declared Taxonomy
node.description: The type-level graph this plugin declares — node types as nodes, declared edge types as directed edges, another plugin's endpoint types distinguished — with live instance counts painted on. Built from manifest declarations, so it is complete on a grid holding no data at all; a declared type nothing has ever used is drawn dashed rather than omitted.
